paragraphs: At the start of the shift, they review drawings and plan material cutting, then use a cutting machine on large slabs. A carving machine roughs out the form before hand tools add details and align veining. In the afternoon, they grind and polish with wheels, measure dimensions and tolerances, clean up stone dust, and lay out the drawing for the next piece.
